name: IpAddress
desc: An IP address (address only, can be assigned to a network interface).

name: Ipv4Address
desc: An IPv4 address (address only, can be assigned to a network interface).

name: Ipv6Address
desc: An IPv6 address (address only, can be assigned to a network interface).

name: IpListener
desc: An IP listener (address and port, can be assigned to a network service).

name: Ipv4Listener
desc: An IPv4 listener (address and port, can be assigned to a network service).

name: Ipv6Listener
desc: An IPv6 listener (address and port, can be assigned to a network service).

name: DnsName
desc: Either a short name or a fully-qualified domain name.

name: MipsProcessor
desc: A processor using the MIPS ISA.

name: Rc
desc: The rc service manager, used on most BSD's.

name: Interpreter
desc: A command or programming language interpreter.

name: Grouping
desc: A group of references to things.

name: Componental
desc: A group for organizing references to components.

name: Actor
desc: Something or someone that interacts/starts/acts within the system.

name: Capability
desc: A software component gives capabilities to its parent or to siblings.

name: State
desc: A capability that makes it possible to state-check.

name: Stop
desc: A capability that makes it possible to stop something.

name: Start
desc: A capability that makes it possible to stop something.

name: Restart
desc: A capability that makes it possible to restart something.

name: Install
desc: A capability that makes it possible to install something.

name: Configure
desc: A capability that makes it possible to configure something.

name: Uninstall
desc: A capability that makes it possible to uninstall something.

name: CreateVm
desc: A capability that makes it possible to create a virtual machine.

name: DestroyVm
desc: A capability that makes it possible to destroy a virtual machine.

name: Execute
desc: A capability that makes it possible to run commands.

name: Detect
desc: A capability that makes it possible for a component to detect itself.

name: List
desc: A capability that makes it possible to list adjacent entities that are children of the current entity.

name: Identify
desc: A capability that makes it possible to identify (version, name, etc) something.

name: SendString
desc: A capability that makes it possible to send a string over a protocol.

name: ReceiveString
desc: A capability that makes it possible to receive a string over a protocol.

name: SendFile
desc: A capability that makes it possible to send a file over a protocol.

name: ReceiveFile
desc: A capability that makes it possible to receive a file over a protocol.

name: Invoke
desc: A capability that makes it possible to invoke a command to execute.

name: Access
desc: A capability that makes it possible to access a textual or graphical console.

name: Verify
desc: A capability that verifies if the current type of the entity is correct. Should return true or false.

name: SMB10
desc: The server message block protocol, version 1.0.

name: SMB20
desc: The server message block protocol, version 2.0.

name: SMB21
desc: The server message block protocol, version 2.1.

name: SMB30
desc: The server message block protocol, version 3.0.

name: Instrument
desc: A representation of a software instrument that gives end user function.

name: Controller
desc: An implementation of an instrument that gives 'behavior'.

name: Marker
desc: Markers are considered 'system' instruments that help us build send<->receive paths.

name: Parser
desc: An instrument that parses raw results from controllers into graphable data.

name: Profile
desc: A profile of software which includes its parts like binaries, data files, directories, etc.
